content: This is a wonderful pie. Is it homemade?
It is, but I didn't make it. Jack did.
I didn't know your husband cooked.
Every week he makes something wonderful. He makes great fresh bread. Sometimes we give some to our neighbors.
What else does your amazing husband do?
Really? I don't even know how to fry an egg.
Jack even does the washing. I spend longer hours traveling from my home to my office and spend fewer hours at home. So he doesn't mind.
Yes, our company is a little far from your home. Who does the cleaning?
We both do. That way it only takes a small part of Saturday.
